_comment: Related guide links on English device pages (scripts/generator/generate-device-pages.js). A device gets byDevice[id] if present, else byCategory[category], else default. Keep each list to 1 or 2 guides. The anchor describes the target page; the note is one plain sentence (BRANDING_UX_UI_GUIDE.md Writing Rules).

video-bitrate-comparison.note: How bitrate and codec set the file size of every minute you record.
